A janitor and a professor were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The janitor recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the professor started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who did very well in high school?
A. Not enough info
B. The professor
C. The janitor
